label: Held-out audio attribution
description: Use validation/test prepared chunks with known CARA labels; strongest source-disjoint attribution evidence.

label: Known-pool prompt recall
description: Prompts derived from held-out metadata and pool/family labels; measures whether generation can recover the intended CARA region.

label: Control-token confound
description: Prompt-only, audio-hidden-only, CARA-text-removed, and shuffled-label probes to expose leakage or shortcuts.

label: Open generation quality
description: Free prompts without known pool labels; reports registry validity, repairability, stability, and quality but not pool accuracy.

label: Adversarial persistence
description: Prompts that stress genre drift, prompt rewriting, and off-distribution generation to test whether CARA attribution persists.

label: Baseline negative control
description: Original models and random/prior/keyword probes; native CARA output is N/A for base checkpoints.

label: Shuffled-label control
description: Same audio/prompt flow with CARA labels shuffled; validates that apparent success is not due to class priors.
